name: bgm-title
prompt:
Slow ambient lo-fi theme. Solo Rhodes electric piano playing one simple four-note motif over a distant warm synth pad. No drums. Melancholy but gentle, the feeling of a room where someone has been waiting a long time.

Instrumental only. No vocals, no singing, no lyrics, no spoken word, no choir. Lo-fi analog production: tape hiss, gentle saturation, muted highs, plenty of space. Loopable, no fade-in, no big drop.
